author: ImJeezus
body:
Yeah, I need a bit of feedback.
Before you go bickering, yes this will be much larger at the end result, and I will attempt to make it have good gameplay. I am also aware it looks like SSB, I will try to make it look somewhat different, gameplay will probably be the same however.
There is two major issues I have currently have however.
1. I have no idea how the hell to do YML.
2. I'm building this whole thing by hand currently.
So, how does the map look? Take a look for yourself
Like I said, any feedback is wanted, as long as it is somewhat constructive.

replies.author: hasl
replies.body:
Honestly, it's so small a so little to go by I can't give practically any feedback, only that the choice of blocks are nice.
For writing up YML feel free to ask any map dev and they should be able to aid you.
I recommend voxel sniper and/or world edit if you don't want to build block by block. Also, if you need any help I'm willing to help you!

replies.author: lockRuby
replies.body:
SSB is a good map for tournaments, and if you are using those features for an Avicus map I'm fine with it as long as it isn't a carbon copy (such as iron room with spacesuits or the antennaes.) Just try to do your best and still be original!

I'm fine with the respawn timer and fine if you want to use supply chests, however please use the default pack and post more progress as time goes by.
